newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end mixed, late-buying lifts index.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end mixed, late-buying lifts index.

text.p: Manila shares ended mixed on Tuesday as the index inched up slightly on late buying in PLDT and SM Prime Holdings shares, traders said.
"Market was down for most of the trading. We seem to be in a consolidation phase," said Norman Cruz, trader at Philippine Asia Securities Inc.
The main index closed up by 0.11 percent, at 3,109.02. Losers outpaced gainers 57 to 50 with 85 unchanged issues.
PLDT rose five pesos to 1,595 pesos a share while SM Prime Holdings rose 10 centavos to 6.30 pesos.
Value turnover was heavy at 3.4 billion pesos with significant buying in Meralco, Metro Pacific, Filinvest and Fil-estate issues, Teresa Lee, Lippo Securities assistant vice-president, said.
Traders said the market will likely move within a trading range for the rest of the week.
All sectors were down except for the commercial-industrial, financial and all shares index. The all-shares index rose by 2.56 points to 1,013.19 points. - KATHERINE ESPINA 63 2 841-8937
